Hello Aysha,

23 August – 22 September: AED 15,500
22 September – 23 October: AED 17,600

The total stay will be 61 nights, and the above will be the applicable rental rates for the respective periods.

This is the final rate we can offer you. Unfortunately, we are unable to reduce the amount further, as this is the best possible rate available from our side.

Thank you for your understanding.
